name: Score Cost
description: Requires the entity to have a certain scoreboard score.

fields.description: The score amount to consume. Defaults to 1.
The icon shown in the UI.
The display text shown in the UI.

name: Multiversal Designation Cost
description: Requires items that carry a designation of a specific universe, like a Multiversal Extrapolator that has found that universe. The items are consumed.

fields.description: The universe the items must be designated to.
How many designated items to consume.

name: Experience Level Cost
description: Requires the entity to have a certain number of experience levels.

fields.description: The number of experience levels to consume.

name: Item Cost
description: Requires the entity to have a certain item in their inventory.

fields.description: How many items to consume. Defaults to 1.

name: Effect Cost
description: Requires a mob/potion effect of a certain rank/amplifier, which is consumed/reduced by the amount.

fields.description: How many levels/amplifier of the effect to consume. Defaults to 1

name: Number Data Attachment Cost
description: Requires the entity to have a certain value in a number data attachment, which is consumed.

fields.description: The ID of the data attachment.
The amount consumed from the data attachment.
The icon shown in the UI.
The display text shown in the UI.
